audit_timing_rejection.error: Initial auditor treated ready_ns (recorded after closing marker) as a lower bound for UI action. Two UI callbacks legitimately observed file creation before that timestamp.
audit_timing_rejection.resolution: Preserve all raw results. Verify sender-side prefix-before-UI order and the marker file; frozen source orders actual recv and receipt recording before exclusive marker creation, and UI requires marker existence. Do not claim ready_ns precedes UI.

fault_injection: A real socket sends a prefix of 1 or 293 bytes then simulates zero progress within original deadlines; Qt acts after the consumer records the prefix. No spontaneous OS backpressure claim.

postprocess_failure.error: Result checker reused the prefix variable for the log marker; int conversion failed after the supervised child had exited. Original logs and supervisor receipts remain intact.
postprocess_failure.fix: Use recorded prefix_bytes; recover results from original logs without rerunning PCSX2.

preparatory_failure.error: Preflight pointed at a nonexistent partial-cancel-clean-v1 instead of immutable ui-cancel-clean-v1. Assertion failed before copying sources or compiling.
